title: Data on Flat Types and Locations for Recent Moderation in HDB Resale Prices
what_it_is: Data on Flat Types and Locations for Recent Moderation in HDB Resale Prices

sections.label: HDB first-timer housing support measures
sections.summary: HDB has taken measures to help first-time buyers live near parents, including more Plus and Prime flats, the Family Care Scheme, and enhanced grants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: The moderation is broad-based across flat types and towns.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: HDB has implemented several key measures in recent years to support first-time buyers to stay near their parents for mutual care and support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: First, we have increased the supply of Plus and Prime flats, which come with additional subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Second, we introduced the Family Care Scheme in 2025 to strengthen inter-generational family support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Third, we have significantly enhanced housing grants for both new and resale flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Eligible first-timer families can benefit from grants of up to $120,000 to buy new flats, and $230,000 to buy resale flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Those purchasing a resale flat can tap on the Proximity Housing Grant of up to $30,000.

sections.label: 2-room Flexi flat supply increase
sections.summary: The supply of 2-room Flexi flats, which singles also apply for, will increase by about 50% from 2026 to 2028.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And for this category, the people who are singles are also applying for 2-room Flexi flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: That is why I shared at the Committee of Supply earlier this year that we will increase the supply of 2-room Flexi flats by about 50% from 2026 to 2028.
